decisions.reason: A multi-model desk line with its own page fits the firm's announced move toward flexible workplace solutions, so its investment and strategic fit argue strongly for persistence.
A chair family close to the core offer and shown on its own page is a low-risk continuation of the firm's established business, and one year is too short to judge it.
The floor cushion line is a visible multi-model offer that complements the rug and lounge range, so management will put any weak early sales down to market build-up.
The sofa is only mentioned on the website, so commitment is lower and dropping it is plausible, but it sits close to the core upholstery offer and is likely kept for now.
The high standing table serves the workplace and conference direction and has its own page, so the firm is likely to keep it.
The rug collection is a publicly presented flagship of the firm's new direction, and that heavy visible commitment makes persistence very likely even though it is distant from the core offer.
